attributes.name: IF1 - Vulnerability and Risk Assessment - Definitions
attributes.proposal: How does the state define extreme INLAND OR STORMWATER FLOODING in its climate resilience plan?

attributes.name: IF2 - Vulnerability and Risk Assessment - Forecasts
attributes.proposal: Does the plan identify the number of projected extreme INLAND OR STORMWATER FLOODING days by 2050, and how does it compare to current conditions?

attributes.name: IF3 - Vulnerability and Risk Assessment - Forecasts
attributes.proposal: Does the plan specify which regions or municipalities face the highest projected INLAND OR STORMWATER FLOODING risk?

attributes.name: IF4 - Vulnerability and Risk Assessment - Forecasts
attributes.proposal: Which specific neighborhoods or census tracts are most vulnerable to INLAND OR STORMWATER FLOODING?

attributes.name: IF5 - Vulnerability and Risk Assessment - Forecasts
attributes.proposal: Does the plan address risks associated with different types of inland flooding?

attributes.name: IF6 - Vulnerability and Risk Assessment - Forecasts
attributes.proposal: How the plan improve the quality and accuracy of flood monitoring and forecasting?

attributes.name: IF7 - Policy and Regulatory Implementation - Building Codes
attributes.proposal: Does the plan propose changes to building codes that promote resilience to flooding?

attributes.name: IF8 - Policy and Regulatory Implementation - Disclosure
attributes.proposal: Does the plan create statewide flood risk disclosure requirements for the rental and sale of residential properties?

attributes.name: IF9 - Policy and Regulatory Implementation - Zoning

attributes.name: IF10 - Policy and Regulatory Implementation - Regulatory

attributes.name: IF12 - Local Capacity Building - Supporting Local Governments
attributes.proposal: Does the plan encourage municipalities to collaborate in adaptation planning at the watershed level?

attributes.name: IF13 - Local Capacity Building - Supporting Local Governments
attributes.proposal: Does the plan assist municipalities in identifying physical assets most vulnerable to flooding?

attributes.name: IF14 - Local Capacity Building - Supporting Local Governments

attributes.name: IF15 - Local Capacity Building - Supporting Local Governments
attributes.proposal: Does the plan encourage municipal participation in the Community Rating System (CRS) to create discounts National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) premiums for its residents?

attributes.name: IF16 - Local Capacity Building - Community Outreach
attributes.proposal: Does the plan outline public education campaigns about inland flooding risks?

attributes.name: IF17 - Disaster Response and Preparedness - Emergency Response
attributes.proposal: Does the plan improve and fund flood monitoring and early warning systems?

attributes.name: IF18 - Disaster Response and Preparedness - Emergency Identification

attributes.name: IF19 - Disaster Response and Preparedness - Emergency Response
attributes.proposal: Does the plan promote and fund the creation of Resilience Hubs?

attributes.name: IF20 - Disaster Response and Preparedness - Emergency Response
attributes.proposal: Does the plan outline protocols for protecting unhoused residents during inland flooding events?

attributes.name: IF21 - Disaster Response and Preparedness - Emergency Response
attributes.proposal: Does the plan include surge capacity planning for hospitals and EMS during inland flooding events?

attributes.name: IF22 - Adaptation Strategies & Long-Term Actions - Flooding Mitigation

attributes.name: IF24 - Adaptation Strategies & Long-Term Actions - Flooding Mitigation

attributes.name: IF25 - Adaptation Strategies & Long-Term Actions - Flooding Mitigation
attributes.proposal: Does the plan encourage the use of green infrastructure to reduce runoff?

attributes.proposal: Does the plan offer voluntary buyouts or relocation assistance to people living in floodplains?

attributes.name: IF27 - Adaptation Strategies & Long-Term Actions - Infrastructure

attributes.name: IF28 - Adaptation Strategies & Long-Term Actions - Infrastructure

attributes.name: IF29 - Adaptation Strategies & Long-Term Actions - Infrastructure

attributes.name: IF30 - Equity & Environmental Justice - Distribution of Impacts

attributes.name: IF35 - Equity & Environmental Justice - Distribution of Impacts
